item.title: Right filter signal is faulty, 20th August
item.description:
The right turn green arrow at this junction is faulty. Specifically, it only comes on for 4 seconds before going to red. This means only 1 or 2 cars makes it through, which is causing tailbacks as far back as the A40. This is compounded by the fact it only comes on if the car at the front crosses the line. A lot of drivers don't know they have to do this because there isn't a sign. So it often doesn't come on at all because the car at front doesn't move forward to activate it. Please increase the length of time the right arrow stays on. Please also put up a sign to tell motorists to pull forward on green.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 192, Cheltenham Road, Elmbridge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
